text:
elaine_cs: Hey team — Zenith (mid-market fintech) onboarding, demo next week. Usage up ~12% but p95 latency spiked to 840ms. Renewal ping in ~6w. Thoughts on proactive perf tweaks? :thinking_face:
vikram_infra: Quick wins: enable INT8 quant on their dedicated GPU pool (rtx-series). Should cut token cost ~25% and knock down latency. Need compatibility check on the model and a short canary.
samira_se: They currently use redwood/model-mix/simcse-13b. INT8 support exists but we should run a 1-hr canary and collect heatmap + quality deltas. I can run the canary if someone drops the routing config.
vikram_infra: Example policy snippet to start the canary:
```
route: zenith-prod
policy:
  primary: simcse-13b-int8
  fallback: simcse-13b-quant-approx
  routing:
    prefer: dedicated-rtx
    overflow: hosted-lowcost
```
samira_se: Also propose a model-hop to simcse-7b-qlora for tail-heavy prompts — 2-3x lower latency, modest tradeoff on abstractive summarization. We can A/B it at 10% traffic to measure UX impact.
elaine_cs: FYI renewal risk: CS health score slipped to 64 this week. Main friction is latency during peak demo flows. If we can promise <500ms p95 for the demo that'll materially improve the renewal convo.
jordan_pm: @samira_se can you prepare a one-slide perf vs quality delta with the eval prompts we ran? @elaine_cs we'll put that in the renewal brief.
samira_se: On it — will include per-prompt latency, token cost delta, and a small diff on rouge/accuracy. I'll upload artifact link when ready.
opsbot: [deploy-bot] Canary deployment started: simcse-13b-int8 -> zenith-canary (10%) by vikram_infra at 3850012355
vikram_infra: Canary looks healthy so far — p95 dropped from 840ms -> 420ms on canary nodes. CPU/GPU utilization stable.
elaine_cs: Sweet. Can we schedule a short enablement session with the customer's product demo team? Need a script for expected behavior and quick workarounds if we see hallucination uptick.
samira_se: Quality checks from the first 30m canary run: eval set shows initial delta within ±1.2% on key prompts; no obvious drift on entity extraction. I'll keep monitoring.
elaine_cs: I'll capture direct customer feedback during the demo: ask them to flag hallucinations and note perceived speed. I will log verbatim snippets in the renewal doc.
jordan_pm: Recommend making the routing policy sticky for known low-latency routes during the demo window so sessions don't bounce to hosted fallback.
vikram_infra: Added sticky routing TTL=30m to the policy for demo window.
samira_se: Next steps checklist:
1) finish canary -> promote to 50% if stable
2) run simcse-7b-qlora A/B at 10% for tail flows
3) prepare the perf/quality slide and upload artifact
4) enablement session Wed 11am PT (90m) with product + demo team
elaine_cs: Thanks team — low-effort wins + concrete numbers should reduce renewal friction. :thumbsup: I'll update the renewal playbook and CC acct exec.
vikram_infra: Ping me if we need extra GPU capacity for the demo window — I can spin a small burst pool.
elaine_cs: Final ask: capture the final routing/quant decision in the renewal doc and attach perf artifact link. I'll send a follow-up invite after the slide is ready.
